parts.question: Compare adverse-event evidence in hn-204 and HN-402 for nausea

result.answer: In HN-204, the treatment-emergent adverse event nausea occurred in 12.7% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the Control group, and was not serious [E1, E3]. In HN-402, nausea occurred in 14.1% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the Control group, and was not serious [E2, E3]. Both HN-204 and HN-402 are SUPPORTING EVIDENCE (global study), NOT LOCAL GUIDANCE [E1, E2]. The treatment % for nausea in HN-402 was 1.4 points higher than in HN-204, while the control % for nausea was 0.0 points higher in HN-402 compared to HN-204 [E4].
